title: Profiling and verifying the substrates of E3 ubiquitin ligase Rsp5 in yeast cells
protocol: Revive YPH499 cells from the glycerol stock stored at -80°C.
Streak the cells on a fresh YPD plate.
Incubate the plate in a 30°C incubator overnight until colonies appear.
Pick a colony from the fresh plate (less than one week old).
Use the picked colony to inoculate a 5 mL YPD culture in a 15 mL culture tube.
Incubate the culture at 30°C with overnight shaking.
Measure the optical density of the cell culture at 600 nm (OD600) the next day.
Dilute the cell culture to an OD600 of 0.2 in 20 mL fresh YPD media with a 50 mL sterilized tube.
Incubate the diluted culture at 30°C with shaking until its OD600 reaches the mid-log phase (OD600 = 0.4–0.6).
Boil 10 mg/mL of ssDNA at 100°C in a water bath to melt the strands and store on ice.
Spin down yeast cells at 1,800 × g for 3 min.
Discard the media and resuspend the cells with 1 mL sterile water.
Transfer 1 mL resuspended cells to a clean, sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Wash cells again with 1 mL TE/LiOAc buffer.
Spin down the cells and remove the remaining liquid.
Resuspend the cells with 2-pellet volumes of TE/LiOAc buffer.
Aliquot 50 μL of cells to clean and sterile tubes.
Add 1 μL (∼ 1 μg) of each plasmid and 5 μL of ssDNA to the cells.
Pipette the cells to mix them well with the plasmids.
Add 300 μL PEG 4000/LiOAc/TE to the mixture and vortex thoroughly.
Shake the tubes at 30°C for 30 min.
Add 35 μL DMSO to each transformation mixture and vortex for 10–30 s.
Heat shock the transformation mixture by putting the tubes in a 42°C water bath for 15 min.
Spin down the cells at 1,800 × g for 3 min.
Wash the cells with 1 mL of sterile water.
Spin down the cells again at 1,800 × g for 3 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 100 μL sterile water.
Plate resuspensions onto SC Dex ura- trp- plates.
Incubate the plates in a 30°C incubator for 1–2 days until colonies appear.
Pick colonies from transformation plates.
Inoculate each colony into 5 mL SC Dex ura- trp- media.
Culture the cells overnight at 30°C with shaking at 220 rpm.
Dilute the culture to an OD600 of 0.3 in 150 mL SC Dex ura- trp- media supplemented with 4 μM biotin.
Shake the diluted culture at 30°C for 5–6 hours until the OD600 reaches 1.0.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 1,800 × g for 5 minutes.
Wash cell pellet three times with 30 mL deionized water.
Resuspend cells in a total volume of 150 mL SC ura- trp- media containing 1% raffinose.
Incubate resuspended cells in a 30°C shaker for 2 hours.
Add 20% galactose to the culture to achieve a final concentration of 2% (w/v).
Culture the induced cells overnight at 30°C with shaking.
Aliquot the overnight culture into three 50 mL Falcon tubes.
Centrifuge each tube at 1,800 × g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash cell pellets.
Resuspend each pellet in 1 mL DI water.
Transfer cell suspension to clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge each tube to remove DI water.
Resuspend the cell pellet with an equal volume of Buffer A (0.2–0.4 mL).
Lysate cells by adding an equal volume of glass beads and beating for 60 seconds using Mini-Beadbeater-16, repeating this process four times in total.
Transfer the cell lysate to a centrifuge tube.
Add 4-5 μL of Antifoam C Emulsion during bead-beating to avoid foaming.
Cool samples on ice for about 1 minute after each cycle.
Centrifuge the cell lysate at 20,000 g for 30 minutes.
Transfer and combine clear supernatant from centrifugation into a clean tube.
Save 50 μL of the lysate as "lysate" for western blot analysis.
Dilute the lysate 1,000-fold prior to measuring protein concentration using Bradford assay.
Measure the protein concentration of diluted lysate at 595 nm with a spectrophotometer.
Pause point: Check the expression of xE1, xE2, and xE3 in yeast lysates by SDS-PAGE and western blot probed with anti-Flag (xE1), anti-V5 (xE2) and anti-myc (xE3) antibodies.
Wash Ni-NTA Sepharose resin 3 times with Buffer A (pH 8.0).
Add the resin to the cell lysate at a ratio of 35 μL resin for 1 mg of protein in the lysate.
Incubate the binding mixture with the Ni-NTA resin at room temperature with gentle rocking for 2 h.
Transfer the resin into a clean CrystalCruz® Chromatography Column (Santa Cruz, sc-205552).
Drain the supernatant into a collection tube and save as "flowthrough 1″ for western blot analysis.
Wash sequentially with 20 bed volumes of Buffer A (pH 8.0), Buffer A (pH 6.3), and Buffer A supplemented with 10 mM imidazole (pH 6.3).
Collect all the wash buffer from the column as "wash 1″ for western blot analysis.
Close the top and bottom of the column.
Add 5-bed volume of Buffer B (pH 4.3) to elute the protein from the Ni-NTA resin.
Incubate the mixture on a platform rotator at room temperature for 5–10 min to elute proteins bound to the resin.
Adjust pH of the eluent solution to 8.0 with 0.1 M NaOH.
Save 50 μL as "elution" for western blot analysis.
Add 10 μL streptavidin-agarose beads for each mg of protein in the cell lysate input.
Incubate the mixture with gentle rocking at room temperature.
Spin down the streptavidin resin at 120 × g for 1 min the next morning.
Save the supernatant as "flowthrough 2" for western blot analysis.
Wash the streptavidin resin by resuspending sequentially with 1.5 mL of each of Buffer C, Buffer D, and Buffer E.
Centrifuge the tubes after each wash to collect the beads.
Save the wash solution as "wash 2" for western blot analysis.
Keep the streptavidin resin bound with HBT-xUB conjugated proteins in 1 mL Buffer E.
Save a sample of streptavidin resin for western blot analysis.
Transfer 50 μL of the resin resuspension to a clean tube.
Wash the resin three times with 500 μL of PBS each time.
Add 10 μL of 6× SDS loading buffer to 50 μL samples collected from step 32c, 34c, 34e, 35e, 37b, 37d and 39b.
Mix the samples thoroughly.
Boil the mixed samples at 100°C for 5 minutes.
Load 10 μL of each sample to a PAGE gel for western blot analysis.
Use an anti-UB antibody to probe for substrate proteins conjugated with HBT-xUB.
Check the results from the western blot.
Wash beads with ABC buffer.
Add 300 μL streptavidin beads to a PierceTM spin column with a crew cap.
Wash the beads with 400 μL of 50 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (ABC) buffer three times.
Add 297 μL ABC and 3 μL of 100 mM DTT dissolved in 50 mM ABC buffer to the beads.
Incubate for 1 hour with shaking and rotation at 37°C.
Add 3 μL of 500 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) in ABC buffer to the bead mixture to give a final concentration of 5 mM IAA in the solution.
Incubate the mixture in the dark at room temperature with rotation for 40 minutes.
Remove the solution by centrifugation.
Wash the beads once with 300 μL ABC.
Dissolve PierceTM Lys-C Endoproteinase in 50 mM ABC buffer.
Prepare a 20 μg/mL stock solution of Lys-C Endoproteinase.
Add 200 μL ABC buffer and 50 μL stock solution to the beads.
Incubate the mixture for 4 h with shaking at 37°C.
Add 2 μg (5 μL) Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin to the mixture.
Digest overnight at 37°C.
Centrifuge the mixture to spin down the beads.
Collect the supernatant solution.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μL water each time.
Combine the wash solutions with the supernatant solution.
Freeze the combined solution at -80°C.
Lyophilize the frozen solution.
Submit the sample for proteomics analysis.
Calculate the ratio of peptide spectrum matches (PSMs) numbers of the proteins purified from OUT and control cells.
Identify the proteins with a PSM ratio greater than 2 between the two cell populations.
Calculate the p-values of PSM by student’s t-test for all the proteins identified by proteomics.
Convert the p-values to -Log10 p-values.
Transform the pET expression plasmid of each protein into BL21 electrocompetent E coli cells by electroporation.
Add 1 mL of SOC to the transformed cells and shake in a 37°C incubator for an hour.
Streak 100–200 μL of recovered cells on LB-agar plate supplemented with antibiotics.
Incubate the plates overnight at 37°C until colonies appear.
Pick a single colony from the transformation plate.
Inoculate 5 mL 2XYT in a 15 mL culture tube supplemented with antibiotics.
Grow the culture overnight at 37°C in a shaker.
Add the overnight culture to 500 mL 2XYT in a 2L sterilized flask with proper antibiotics.
Allow the cell to grow for 4–6 h until OD600 reaches 0.6–0.8.
Add 1M IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM.
Shake the induced culture at 16°C overnight (16–20 h) to induce protein expression.
Spin down the cells at 7,000 × g for 20 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 10 mL lysis buffer.
Add 20 mg lysozyme.
Incubate the cell suspension on ice for 30 min.
Sonicate the cells for 30 min (5 s on and 5 s off cycle) on ice to avoid overheating.
Always put the cells in an ice-water mixture during sonication.
Transfer the lysate into centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 30,000 × g for 30 min.
Collect the supernatant by transferring it to a new and clean 50 mL tube.
Wash 500 μL of Ni-NTA beads with 1 mL PBS three times.
Add Ni-NTA beads to the cell lysate.
Incubate the mixture overnight at 4°C with rotation.
Load the suspension into a clean gravity-flow column.
Wash once with 15 mL lysis buffer.
Wash twice with 15 mL wash buffer sequentially.
Close the stopper of the column, resuspend beads with 5 mL elution buffer, and wait for 10–15 minutes.
Open the stopper to collect the eluate.
Put the eluate into a dialysis bag with proper MW cutoff.
Dialyze in 1 L dialysis buffer at 4°C overnight.
Put the dialysis bag in fresh dialysis buffer and dialyze for 3 hours at 4°C the next day.
Concentrate the dialyzed protein using an appropriate size Amicon ultra centrifugal filter unit.
Measure the concentration of the purified protein.
Aliquot the purified protein into 1.5 mL tubes.
Store the aliquoted protein at -80°C.
Thaw UB, UB-transferring enzymes, and substrate proteins on ice.
Set up 50 μL in vitro ubiquitination reactions for each substrate with control reactions missing E1, E2, or E3.
Incubate the reaction mixture with shaking for 1–2 hours at 37°C.
Add 10 μL 6× SDS loading dye to quench the reactions.
Boil the tubes at 100°C for 5 minutes.
Perform a Western blot of the ubiquitination reactions.
Load 10 μL of boiled samples to Bio-Rad 4%–20% precast gel for electrophoresis.
Transfer protein bands from the gel to a PVDF membrane with Trans-Blot® Turbo™ RTA Mini PVDF Transfer Kit.
Block the PVDF membrane with 5% non-fat milk for 1 hour.
Dilute a primary antibody in 5% non-fat milk at a proper dilution ratio.
Incubate the PVDF membrane with the antibody solution at 4°C overnight with shaking.
Wash membranes with TBS-T buffer three times.
Incubate membranes with secondary antibody (1:20,000, goat anti-mouse or goat anti-rabbit antibody) at room temperature for an hour.
Wash membranes with TBS-T buffer three times.
Prepare 2 mL of fresh developing solution (SuperSignal® West Pico Chemiluminescent Substrate) for each piece of membrane.
Apply the developing solution onto the membrane and wait for 2 minutes.
Remove excess liquid from the membrane.
Expose the membrane to an autoradiography film in a dark room or use equipment capable of detecting chemiluminescence for imaging.
Conditionally express Rsp5-DN with a premature stop codon at L451.
Cloned Rsp5-DN into the pYES vector under the pGAL promoter.
Inoculate 3–5 mL YPD media with glycerol stock of cim3-1 strain.
Culture cells in a 25°C shaker to prepare for yeast cotransformation.
Plate transformed yeast cells on the SC Dex ura- leu- plates.
Incubate the plates at 25°C for 3–4 days until colonies appear.
Induce cim3-1 cells transformed with pYES-URA-Rsp5-DN to express Rsp5-DN on galactose plates.
Do not induce expression of Rsp5-DN in cim3-1 cells on dextrose plates.
Incubate cells at 37°C to check for growth inhibition due to Rsp5-DN expression.
Select colonies cotransformed with pYES-URA-Rsp5-DN and pESC-Leu-substrate plasmids showing specific phenotypes.
Assay the ubiquitination of Rsp5 substrates in selected cell clones.
Prepare selection plates with SC ura- leu- medium containing dextrose.
Prepare selection plates with SC ura- leu- medium containing galactose.
Draw rows of squares on the back of each plate.
Pick 6 to 8 single colonies from each transformation reaction.
Resuspend each colony in 30 μL of sterile water in separate tubes.
Add 1 μL of resuspended cells to the center of each square on both dextrose and galactose plates.
Spread the liquid drop with a sterilized inoculating loop.
Incubate dextrose plates at 25°C overnight or longer until colonies appear.
Incubate galactose plates at 37°C overnight or longer until colonies appear.
Pick up colonies from dextrose plates with cotransformation of plasmids expressing substrate proteins and wt Rsp5 or Rsp5-DN.
Inoculate 5 mL of SC Dex ura- leu- medium with each colony.
Grow the culture overnight at 25°C with shaking.
Use the 5 mL overnight culture to inoculate 35 mL of SC Dex ura- leu- medium for another overnight culture at 25°C.
Change yeast cells from dextrose medium to galactose medium.
Pellet cells at 1,800 × g for 3 min.
Wash cells three times with 1 mL DI water.
Remove all liquid after washing.
Transfer all cells into 35 mL of SC Gal ura- leu- medium.
Grow cells overnight in a 25°C shaker.
Shift cells to galactose medium to induce gene expression under pGAL promoter.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 7–8 hours to induce proteasome-deficiency.
Centrifuge cells at 1,800 × g for 5 minutes.
Wash the pellet with sterile water.
Add 10 pellet-volumes of ice-cold RIPA buffer containing yeast protease inhibitor cocktail and PMSF to the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cells in RIPA buffer and transfer to 15 mL tubes on ice.
Add 1 pellet-volume of 0.5 mm acid-washed glass beads to each tube.
Vortex the tubes for 30 seconds, then place them on ice for 30 seconds.
Repeat vortexing and cooling cycles 12 times.
Centrifuge the cell lysate mixture at 3,200 × g for 5 minutes.
Collect the supernatant and transfer it to a regular 1.5 mL tube.
Precipitate cell debris by centrifugation at 20,000 × g for 10–15 minutes at 4°C.
Measure total protein concentration in the clarified lysate by Bradford assay after diluting the lysate 1,000-fold.
Transfer the same amount of protein lysate into a fresh tube.
Add 6xSDS-PAGE loading dye to the protein lysate.
Boil the tubes at 100°C for 5 minutes.
Load the cell lysate onto a gel and perform SDS PAGE.
Probe the western blots with an anti-Flag or substrate-specific antibody to check the expression of substrates in the co-transformed cells.
Wash M2 agarose anti-Flag beads three times with RIPA buffer.
Equilibrate the beads with RIPA buffer in a 50% slurry.
Add 25 μL of M2-agarose anti-Flag beads to each tube.
Fix the tubes on a rotator.
Rotate the sample tubes at 4°C for 2–6 h for thorough mixing.
Wash the beads 3 times with RIPA buffer.
Boil the beads at 100°C with 25 μL of 1xSDS-PAGE loading dye for 5 min to release proteins from the beads.
Load 10 μL of the samples onto Bio-Rad precast 8% SDS-PAGE gels for western blot analysis.
Reconstitute SEY6210.1 and YXY705 cells in YPD media at 25°C.
Prepare transformation reaction with 1 μL (∼1 μg) pCM189-URA-substrate-Flag plasmids expressing Flag-tagged substrates.
Plate transformed yeast cells onto SC Dex ura- plates.
Incubate plates at 25°C for 3–4 days until colonies appear.
Pick a single colony from each plate and inoculate 4 mL of SC Dex ura- media.
Aliquot to two separated 15 mL tubes.
Add doxycycline to one tube to a final concentration of 2 μg/mL.
Culture both tubes at 25°C overnight with shaking.
Centrifuge cells in both tubes at 1,800 × g for 3 min.
Resuspend cells and boil with 30 μL 1× SDS loading dye at 100°C for 10–15 minutes.
Spin down cell debris at 16,000 × g for 1 minute.
Load 10 μL supernatant to SDS-PAGE gel.
Conduct western blot analysis with anti-Flag antibody to check substrate expression under TET-off system.
Pick colonies from plates in the morning.
Inoculate 2 mL of SC Dex ura- media with the picked colonies.
Incubate culture tubes at 25°C with shaking.
Dilute starting culture into 40 mL of media in a 250 mL sterilized flask in the evening.
Incubate the flask at 25°C overnight with shaking.
Measure OD600 of the culture the next morning to ensure it is in the mid-log phase (0.4–0.6).
If OD600 is too high, dilute the culture to 0.2 and grow it again to mid-log phase.
Shift the culture to 37°C for 20 min to prewarm the cells.
Prewarm fresh media to 37°C.
Spin down the cells.
Resuspend the pellet in 40 mL of prewarmed SC Dex ura- media supplemented with 2 μg/mL doxycycline.
Measure OD600 again and collect 7 OD600 of cells.
Calculate the volume of cells collected using V = 7/OD600 from the current culture.
Return the culture to the 37°C shaker.
Treat cells with TCA.
Pellet the cells in the collected culture by centrifugation.
Resuspend the cell pellets with 1 mL of 10% TCA.
Incubate the cell suspension on ice for 30 min.
Measure the OD600 of the cell culture growing at 37°C every 2 h (at 0, 2 and 4 h).
Collect 7 OD600 of cells at each time point.
Repeat the treatment with all samples collected.
Store cells treated with TCA at 4°C for one week after the last sample collection.
Spin down cells in the TCA solution at 16,000 × g for 1 min and remove the supernatant.
Wash the cell pellet with 500 μL of 0.1% ice-cold TCA.
Spin down the cells again at 16,000 × g for 1 min and carefully remove all supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 70 μL of 2× urea boiling buffer and one pellet-volume of glass beads.
Lysate the cells by bead-beating for 5 min using Mini-Beadbeater-16.
Quickly spin down the samples to settle the beads to the bottom.
Heat the tube to 42°C for 5 min to aid protein denaturation.
Add 70 μL of 2× urea sample buffer with DTT.
Repeat steps involving bead-beating lysis to thoroughly lyse the cells.
Centrifuge the cell lysates at 16,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant carefully to a fresh tube.
Analyze the samples by SDS-PAGE and western blot.
Use the anti-Flag antibody to probe for Flag-tagged substrates.
Use an anti-G6PDH antibody to probe for G6PDH as a loading control.
